description: This file defines the GatewayPushSubscription enum with static methods for subscribing to push notifications and managing background tasks related to GatewayPush data streams.

methods.name: consume
methods.description: Asynchronously subscribes to GatewayPush updates, processes incoming pushes, and invokes the provided callback on the main actor.

methods.name: restartTask
methods.description: Restarts a background task that consumes GatewayPush updates, cancelling the existing task if present and starting a new one.
